faqs.question: What is the Heidolph Hei-SHAKE Orbital Expert used for?
faqs.answer: The Hei-SHAKE Orbital Expert is an orbital shaker built for everyday lab mixing, including bacterial suspensions, cell culture work, staining and washing steps, solubility studies, and automated shaking setups where consistency matters run after run.

faqs.question: What is the speed range of the Hei-SHAKE Orbital Expert?
faqs.answer: The Hei-SHAKE Orbital Expert runs from 1 to 530 rpm, so one instrument covers everything from gentle mixing to vigorous agitation without switching equipment.

faqs.question: What is the shaking diameter (orbit) of the Hei-SHAKE Orbital Expert?
faqs.answer: The Hei-SHAKE Orbital Expert moves samples in a 20 mm orbit, keeping mixing even and homogeneous across the platform.

faqs.question: Does the Hei-SHAKE Orbital Expert support data logging?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Hei-SHAKE Orbital Expert logs run data over USB, so shaking conditions are easy to document and revisit.

faqs.question: Can the Hei-SHAKE Orbital Expert be remotely controlled?
faqs.answer: Yes, an RS 232 interface lets the Hei-SHAKE Orbital Expert be controlled remotely, useful when it's part of a larger automated setup.

faqs.question: Is the Hei-SHAKE Orbital Expert's display usable with gloves on?
faqs.answer: Yes, the capacitive touch display on the Hei-SHAKE Orbital Expert is glove-compatible, built for hands-on lab conditions rather than a clean-room-only interface.

faqs.question: Is the Hei-SHAKE Orbital Expert suitable for automated or robotic systems?
faqs.answer: Yes, platform alignment on the Hei-SHAKE Orbital Expert can be programmed to within 2 degrees, so a robotic arm can place or remove samples reliably every time.

faqs.question: What is the timer range of the Hei-SHAKE Orbital Expert?
faqs.answer: The Hei-SHAKE Orbital Expert's timer runs from 1 second up to 999 hours, 59 minutes and 59 seconds, covering everything from short spot-checks to multi-day runs.

faqs.question: Does the Hei-SHAKE Orbital Expert support saved methods for repeat use?
faqs.answer: Yes, saved profiles and favorites on the Hei-SHAKE Orbital Expert mean a routine method is one tap away, instead of resetting parameters each time.

body: The Hei-SHAKE Orbital Expert is built for labs that need shaking to just work, every time, with smooth, uniform motion that keeps mixing consistent and homogeneous across routine and controlled workflows. Platform alignment can be programmed to within 2°, which matters the moment a robotic arm starts placing or removing samples on its own.
